epics.title: Epic 2.1: Listings backend
epics.intro: One Listing model, three types (stay/car/tour) via JSONB attributes + PostGIS location. Design: docs/system-design.md §3.3, §4.

issues.title: Listing, Photo, Amenity migrations: type enum, JSONB attributes, PostGIS point
issues.body:
## Context
The central data model of the product (docs/system-design.md §3.3).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Listing: type enum (stay|car|tour), title, description, JSONB attributes, location point, base_price, currency, status enum (draft|pending_review|active|paused)
- [ ] Photo: listing_id, url, position, is_cover
- [ ] Amenity + ListingAmenity join table
- [ ] PostGIS extension enabled in migration

issues.title: Type-specific zod schemas for stay/car/tour attributes in packages/shared
issues.body:
## Context
JSONB in the DB, type safety at the boundary — these schemas are the contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] StayAttributes (rooms, beds, maxGuests…), CarAttributes (seats, transmission, fuel…), TourAttributes (durationDays, maxGroupSize, itinerary[]…)
- [ ] Discriminated union ListingAttributes by type
- [ ] Unit tests with valid + invalid payloads

issues.title: POST /api/v1/listings — create draft listing (host only)
issues.body:
## Context
First listings endpoint in `modules/listings/`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] requireRole('host'); validates with the discriminated union schema
- [ ] Creates with status=draft, owner = current user
- [ ] Tests: guest → 403, invalid attributes for type → 400

issues.title: PATCH /api/v1/listings/:id with object-level ownership check
issues.body:
## Context
THE classic security bug (BOLA/IDOR) — host A must not edit host B's listing. docs/system-design.md §8.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Owner or admin only; other host → 403 (test this explicitly!)
- [ ] Partial update; type immutable after creation
- [ ] Tests for ownership matrix

issues.title: Photo upload: multi-image, ordering, cover selection, validation
issues.body:
## Context
Reuses the avatar-upload storage pattern from Phase 1.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /listings/:id/photos (multi), ≤10 photos, ≤5 MB each, jpeg/png/webp
- [ ] PATCH to reorder and set cover; DELETE removes from storage too
- [ ] Ownership checks everywhere; tests with mocked storage

issues.title: Amenity seed data + attach/detach amenities on a listing
issues.body:
## Context
Wifi, parking, AC, child seat, guide language… per listing type.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Seed script with ~30 amenities grouped by listing type
- [ ] PUT /listings/:id/amenities replaces the set; invalid ids → 400
- [ ] Tests

issues.title: Publish flow: draft → pending_review → active with validation gate
issues.body:
## Context
A listing must be complete before going live; admins approve in Phase 6 (auto-approve until then).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /listings/:id/publish checks completeness (≥3 photos, description ≥100 chars, price, location)
- [ ] Incomplete → 422 problem+json listing what's missing
- [ ] State machine enforced (no draft → active skipping validation); tests

issues.title: CalendarDay model + GET/PUT availability (block dates, price overrides)
issues.body:
## Context
Availability is the foundation booking (Phase 4) is built on. docs/system-design.md §4.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] CalendarDay: listing_id, date, status (available|blocked), price_override — unique (listing_id, date)
- [ ] GET /listings/:id/availability?from&to; PUT bulk block/unblock range
- [ ] Owner-only writes; tests incl. range edge cases

issues.title: GET /api/v1/listings/:id — full public detail (photos, amenities, host card)
issues.body:
## Context
The payload behind the listing detail page.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Active listings public; drafts visible to owner/admin only (404 for others)
- [ ] Includes ordered photos, amenities, host public card
- [ ] Response shape as shared zod schema; tests

issues.title: GET /api/v1/my/listings — host dashboard list
issues.body:
## Context
Everything the current host owns, all statuses.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Returns own listings with status, cover photo, created_at
- [ ] Pagination headers (X-Total-Count); test

issues.title: Integration test: full listing lifecycle (create → photos → publish → fetch)
issues.body:
## Context
End-to-end module test, like the Phase 1 auth lifecycle test.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] One test walks: create draft → upload photos → set amenities → set availability → publish → public GET
- [ ] Runs in CI against test DB

epics.title: Epic 2.2: Listings frontend
epics.intro: Create-listing wizard, host dashboard, public listing page.

issues.title: Create-listing wizard shell: type → details → photos → pricing → publish
issues.body:
## Context
Multi-step form container; each step is its own issue.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /host/listings/new with step indicator, next/back, draft persisted between steps
- [ ] Step routing (refresh keeps your place)
- [ ] Type chosen at step 1 drives later steps

issues.title: Wizard step: stay details form (rooms, beds, guests, address)
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Form bound to StayAttributes shared schema
- [ ] Map pin drag to set location
- [ ] Component test for validation

issues.title: Wizard step: car details form (seats, transmission, fuel, pickup location)
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Form bound to CarAttributes shared schema
- [ ] Pickup location via map pin
- [ ] Component test for validation

issues.title: Wizard step: tour details form (duration, group size, itinerary builder)
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Form bound to TourAttributes shared schema
- [ ] Itinerary: add/remove/reorder day entries
- [ ] Component test for validation

issues.title: Wizard step: photo upload with drag-drop reorder and cover selection
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Multi-file drop zone with previews + per-file progress
- [ ] Drag to reorder; click to set cover; delete
- [ ] Errors for too-big/wrong-type files surfaced per file

issues.title: Wizard step: pricing + cancellation policy picker
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Base price + currency (KGS/USD/EUR)
- [ ] Policy cards: Flexible / Moderate / Strict with plain-language explanation
- [ ] Publish button calls publish endpoint; 422 gaps rendered as a checklist

issues.title: Availability calendar UI: month grid, block/unblock, price overrides
issues.body:
## Context
Hosts manage when their listing is bookable.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Month view; drag across dates to block/unblock a range
- [ ] Set price override for selected dates
- [ ] Optimistic updates with rollback; component tests

issues.title: Host dashboard: my listings table with status badges and actions
issues.body:
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /host/listings: cover, title, type, status badge, edit/calendar links
- [ ] Empty state pointing to the wizard
- [ ] Component test

issues.title: Public listing detail page: gallery, amenities, map, host card, calendar
issues.body:
## Context
The most important page of the product.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] /listings/[id]: photo gallery, attributes by type, amenities, map, host card, availability calendar (read-only)
- [ ] SSR with metadata (title = listing title)
- [ ] 404 page for unknown/draft listings

issues.title: ListingCard component in a shared UI location
issues.body:
## Context
Used by search results (Phase 3), wishlists (Phase 5), host dashboard.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Cover photo, title, type badge, price/night (or /day, /person), rating placeholder
- [ ] Component test; used on the host dashboard
